title: First round
text: Let $$u=x^2$$ and $$dv=cos\left(x\right) dx$$, so $$du=2x dx$$ and $$v=sin(x)$$. This gives $$x^2 sin\left(x\right)$$ minus the integral of $$2x sin\left(x\right)$$.

title: Second round
text: Use integration by parts again on the integral of $$2x sin\left(x\right)$$, with $$u=2x$$ and $$dv=sin\left(x\right) dx$$. It equals $$-2x cos\left(x\right)+2sin\left(x\right)$$.
